Use case: ui-mockup. A premium production-quality COMPLETE website UI mockup for azərtur, Azerbaijan inbound travel, English interface. Original design continuing the approved homepage in reference image 1. Warm white #FAF8F4, charcoal #202624, restrained orange #EE7845 rectangular primary buttons, forest #304B3D, pale sage sections, modern Manrope-like confident sans-serif. Sharp 4px corners, thin rules, fine line icons, generous editorial whitespace. Use full canvas from navigation to COMPLETE footer, readable crisp text, aligned exact grid. No device frames, perspective, moodboard, pills, badges, eyebrows, neon, decorative gradients, heavy shadows, fake reviews, invented customer counts, scarcity or discounts. Image 1 is STYLE/BRAND reference, NOT page to reproduce. Subsequent references are actual project photographic ASSETS to reuse faithfully inside this new page, not new destinations. Show prices as sample indicative amounts, never guaranteed availability or instant booking. Customer selects options then registers and submits a request for operator review; contract approval and deposit occur only after operator confirms offer. No payment or contract actions on this screen. Cancellation policy varies by service/provider and request timing, no universal percentage or deadline.
Asset type: SINGLE COMPLETE FULL-LENGTH DESKTOP TOUR CATALOG, desired canvas 1536 wide x 2560 tall, not just top screen. Source photos: image 2 Khinalug, image 3 Sheki, image 4 Baku. Do not add inventory: exactly THREE different tour cards.
Page composition in order:
1. Same slim white header as homepage with orange A + azərtur, Tours (active underline), Destinations, Create your trip, About us, EUR, EN, My account.
2. Spacious restrained editorial heading "Find your kind of journey." with small supporting sentence "A starting point for your Azerbaijan trip." and a narrow panoramic mountain photo strip beneath. Breadcrumb Home / Tours.
3. Clear horizontal search form on warm white: Destination "All destinations", Travel dates "Choose dates", Travelers "2 travelers", orange "Find a journey". Helper "Final price and availability confirmed by our team."
4. Below: six quiet icon/text tourism category selectors as a horizontal row separated by rules: History / Culture / Medical / Nature / Entertainment / Business. No pill shapes.
5. Main catalog: fixed-looking 250px LEFT FILTER column and broad 2-column results area right. Sidebar title "Refine your journey" and Reset. Labelled checkbox groups Destination (Baku, Sheki, Gabala, Quba & Khinalug), Duration (1 day, 2–3 days, 4+ days), Activity (Easy, Moderate). Price range simple horizontal track €0–€500; note "Sample prices". Result header "3 sample journeys" and native "Sort: Recommended".
6. Three large photo-first cards in two columns, fourth grid slot a tasteful pale sage custom-trip invitation, not a fake tour. Card 1 mountain village image2: "Quba · Khinalug", "Into the highlands", concise sentence "Village paths, wide valleys and a night in the mountains.", icon row "2 days · Moderate", "From €240 / person", small "Sample price", "View itinerary →". Card2 image3: "Sheki · Gabala", "Along the Silk Road", "Palaces, local crafts and a slower pace.", "3 days · Easy", "From €410 / person", "Sample price", "View itinerary →". Card3 image4: "Baku · Old City", "A city of contrasts", "Old stone streets and a city looking forward.", "1 day · Easy", "From €85 / person", "Sample price", "View itinerary →". Sage fourth slot heading "A different route in mind?" supporting "Choose your tours, stays, transfers and experiences." forest "Create your trip →". Use equal image proportions and typography, crisp fine borders. No favorites or ratings.
7. Below results short note "Prices are illustrative. Services and final quote are confirmed before payment." Simple horizontal quiet guidance block "Choose a route. Make it yours." with three numbered steps Browse / Customize / Send a request. Below a minimal line "No matches? Change your filters or ask our team." linked "Get in touch →".
8. Full forest-green footer matching homepage with azərtur wordmark, Explore, Company, Information columns, EN RU AZ and © 2026 azərtur.
Make a compelling generous full page, not a compressed miniature. No fake map.

Asset type: SINGLE COMPLETE FULL-LENGTH DESKTOP TOUR DETAIL PAGE, desired canvas 1536 wide x 3840 tall. Page is for existing tour "Into the highlands", Quba · Khinalug, 2 days, moderate, starting Baku, from €240 per person indicative sample price. Photo references: image2 mountain village is main hero, image3 guesthouse terrace and image4 mountain hikers are secondary gallery photos. Faithfully reuse the supplied visual assets.
COMPLETE composition in exact order:
1. Same slim white navigation as homepage, orange A + azərtur, Tours active, Destinations, Create your trip, About us, EUR EN My account.
2. Breadcrumb Home / Tours / Quba & Khinalug. Large strong heading "Into the highlands" and subhead "Two days. Village paths. A different pace." Under it a calm fine-line icon row "Quba · Khinalug" / "2 days, 1 night" / "Moderate" / "Starts in Baku". Small "Sample itinerary — details to be confirmed".
3. Broad immersive gallery: large mountain-village photo covering left two thirds and two stacked guesthouse/hiking photos in right third. Small rectangular white "View all photos" action on photo, no badges.
4. Main 2-column body: left editorial content 65%, right white fine-border booking/request panel 30%. Above left content a horizontal text anchor nav Overview / Itinerary / Services / Before you go, active underline. Right panel visually sticky at top of body: "From €240 / person", "Sample starting price", fields Travel date "Choose date", Travelers "2 adults", faint rule, "Estimated total €480", "Final quote confirmed by our team." Orange full-width "Customize this trip →", secondary text "Sign in to send your request". Small sequence "Request → Team review → Offer". No immediate payment. Price panel appears once only on desktop.
5. Left heading "A little further from the everyday." and two concise paragraphs about village paths, wide valleys and a night away, realistic example itinerary not tour-guarantees. Three highlight rows with line icons "Mountain village walks", "Local hospitality", "Scenic roads".
6. "Your route, day by day." Followed schematic straight route line Baku → Quba → Khinalug → Baku, clearly labelled "Route overview" not geographic map. Two spacious vertical accordion/timeline days: "Day 1 — From the city to the mountains" expanded with "Leave Baku, pause in Quba and continue towards Khinalug. Walk village paths and settle into your selected stay." concise subrows "Village walk", "Overnight stay, if selected"; "Day 2 — A slow morning. A scenic return." expanded with "Time for a mountain walk before the road back to Baku." Small text "Timing depends on weather, service availability and your final itinerary." No exact fabricated driving durations.
7. "Choose what goes into your trip." Service rows separated by thin rules: Transfers / Local guide / Overnight stay / Experiences, each with small original icon and "Confirm in trip planner" or "Selected separately". Adjacent restrained excluded-list "Flights, visas and personal expenses are not included in this sample." Do not promise guide/hotel/meals included in €240. Small "Itemized prices appear in your quote."
8. Pale sage editorial custom panel: "Like the route. Want to change the rhythm?" short copy and forest "Make this trip yours →", small hiking photo to one side.
9. Full-width "Before you go" with quiet accordion rows "What should I bring?", "How is my request confirmed?", "How do contracts and payments work?", "Changes and cancellation". Last open answer "Each service has its own provider terms. Refunds depend on the service and cancellation time. Our team reviews your request before confirming any refund." No universal deadline/percentage. Contracts/payments row concise "Review the PDF contract and approve the confirmed offer before paying a deposit. Later payments are requested as services become due." As proposed business-flow design, no paid-state UI.
10. "Keep exploring" two smaller related cards from existing inventory only: Along the Silk Road / 3 days / From €410 sample; A city of contrasts /1 day /From €85 sample. If extra photographic references absent use cropped supplied mountain-photo with discreet text; prefer no invented new landmarks.
11. Full forest-green footer matching homepage, complete to bottom with EN RU AZ, © 2026 azərtur.
A complete high-end tour product page, every section legible and fully visible; no bottom cropping, no irrelevant filler or testimonials.
